description: Add prospect photo. Attach a photo to the prospect’s property from base64 (small images) or a public https URL (up to 10 MB). Needs an API key created by a user. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

image_base64.description: Base64 image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP). Keep the request under 1 MB; use `image_url` for larger files.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image to copy in (max 10 MB).

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_prospects_id_photos
